instruction:
Work from a terminal with CalculiX 2.21 (`/usr/bin/ccx`).

`/home/user/Desktop/drawing.svg` is the ONLY source of the geometry and the tip load. Read the drawing, then reconstruct and solve the stepped cantilever:
- steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
- use 10 mm B31 elements along the beam; 13 nodes numbered 1..13 from the clamped root to the tip
- the root and tip segments use the square RECT sections dimensioned in the drawing
- clamp the root node in dofs 1-6; apply the drawing's tip load in the negative y direction

Submit with `/usr/bin/ccx` and produce `/home/user/Desktop/solution.inp` and `/home/user/Desktop/solution.dat`. Results reach `.dat` through `*Node Print` with an explicit node set.

Write `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as one number: `tip_uy`, the y displacement of the tip node, in mm.

The evaluator re-solves your deck independently; the reported number must come from your own run.
